# typeset.us

> Paragraph compositor for the browser: beam-search line breaking with
> syntactic protection and post-render self-verification, for English
> long-form prose. The only typography intervention with a machine-checkable
> definition of done: `Typeset.audit()` returns `[]`.

Install is one script tag (`<script src="https://typeset.us/go.js" defer>`)
or `npm install typeset.us` and `typeset(el)` after `document.fonts.ready`.
Mark framework-re-rendered text with `data-no-typeset`. Verify with
`Typeset.audit() === []` and `data-ts-outcome="composed"`. Measured cost:
1.4 ms median per paragraph in desktop Chromium. The browser types. It
doesn't read.

## Docs

- [For agents](https://typeset.us/for-agents): canonical install, scoping,
  and verification instructions for AI coding agents
- [Library](https://typeset.us/library): the engine's rules, constants, and
  the measurements behind them

## Package

- [typeset.us on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/typeset.us):
  typeset.us@3.5.0, MIT — ESM, CJS, and global builds with types
